status: BLOCKED - the canonical half passes, the counterfactual half cannot run yet
what: Progress of the Greendale end-to-end acceptance for topology-sensitive analysis.

canonicalHalf.note: Matches the audit figure of 7,944.4 m over 17 arcs exactly. The canonical analysis runs first, is pinned, and is returned unchanged.

blocker.what: The `crossings` table is EMPTY for the national snapshot - 0 rows, and 0 rows for any snapshot in the database.
blocker.why: The national snapshot was ingested before crossing detection existed. `crossings` is written by the ingest, and this snapshot predates it.
blocker.consequence: Candidate search has nothing to draw from, so it returns 0 candidates and the run correctly reports sensitivity UNAVAILABLE - which it is careful to distinguish from the answer being robust. The machinery behaved correctly; the input is absent.
blocker.notADefectIn: candidates.find, sensitivityrun.run, or the neighbourhood copy - all of which did the right thing with an empty input.

optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.option: Populate `crossings` for the national snapshot in place
optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.verdict: REFUSED without authorisation. The standing constraint is that the national snapshot is not mutated outside a rolled-back transaction, and this would be a durable write to it.

optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.option: Copy the national snapshot, populate crossings on the copy, run the acceptance there
optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.cost: about 30 s to copy plus a full national crossing detection pass, roughly 10 minutes, and it is a transient copy so nothing national is touched
optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.verdict: Respects every constraint. This is the recommended route.

optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.option: Detect crossings only within the bounded neighbourhood, at analysis time
optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.cost: cheap, and it removes the dependency on a pre-populated table entirely
optionsAndWhyThisNeedsADecision.verdict: Probably the better long-term design, but it is a change to how candidates are sourced and should be a deliberate decision rather than something slipped in to make an acceptance pass.

whatIsProvenSoFar: the canonical analysis is reached, pinned, and reproduces the audit figure exactly
candidate search, the runner, the neighbourhood copy and cleanup all behave correctly on an empty input
sensitivity reports UNAVAILABLE with a reason, and states that this is not the same as the answer being robust
notYetProven: the causal crossing being Clintons Road x McLaughlins Road
Greendale x Clintons being found and correctly NOT credited with the change
canonical and counterfactual geometries visually distinct
